sources.update_cadence: annual source updates; report extrapolations are fixed calculations

sources.title: Mental wellbeing by age and world region

sources.title: GPT-human cultural response correlation
sources.source_citation: Atari, Xue, Park, Blasi and Henrich2025; Which Humans, PsyArXiv5b26t
sources.newest_verified_vintage: 2023 author manuscript verified; no new same-study dataset confirmed
sources.update_cadence: one-off model experiment, not live country series

sources.newest_verified_vintage: Study2025-09-23 through May2025; result package ModifiedBSD3

sources.title: Historical price per computing unit
sources.source_citation: Nordhaus2007 Two Centuries of Productivity Growth in Computing
sources.newest_verified_vintage: No exact newer same-series source verified
sources.access_limitations: Author XLS and PDF fetch blocked/timed out. Need recover exact author archive before normalizing; preserve2006USD unit and specific computation-power denominator; modern GPU costs are not a continuation of this metric.

sources.title: AI effect on case resolutions per hour by skill and tenure
sources.source_citation: Brynjolfsson, Li and Raymond2025 Generative AI at Work QJE140(2)889–942
sources.access_limitations: Primary publication promises replication code only. Raw firm customer chats/worker panel proprietary; Dataverse robot check prevented metadata inspection. Do not replace study estimates with national AI-use data.

sources.title: Newer ChatGPT usage statistics
sources.update_cadence: monthly periods, periodic release; no real-time API verified
sources.access_limitations: CC BY4.0; 25 CSVs, sample300000 classified consumer messages per month July2024–June2026, adults18+, excludes enterprise/Codex, DP noise. Shares rounded3dp, O*NET5dp. Name-associated gender is inferred; country ranks normalize by2023WDI population. Separate related dataset, not report-source replacement.

sources.title: Climate-change beliefs and policy support
sources.access_limitations: Author repo specifies data_55.xlsx; Zenodo record blocked by web. Exact download and record license unresolved. Report cites62 countries while primary final publication reports63/59440; preserve this vintage/coverage distinction. Do not call headline report shares independent national observations.
